stops.note: to stand, to place, combined with de- (away from)
to stand away from, to stop, from de- and sistere
stops.meaning: to stand away from, to stop

stops.note: settled as the English word for stopping an action, especially one that is unwanted
stops.meaning: to stop doing something, especially an unwanted action

current_meaning: to stop doing something, especially an action that is unwanted or harmful
